signature: SUBROUTINE DLAPMR( FORWRD, M, N, X, LDX, K )

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix X. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix X. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: X
params.reference: On entry, the M by N matrix X. On exit, X contains the permuted matrix X.

params.name: ldx
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array X, $\mathrm{LDX} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: k
params.reference: On entry, K contains the permutation vector. K is used as internal workspace, but reset to its original value on output.
